title: Prove sharp outside-span E8 A2 rank-six capacity
body:
## Summary

```diff
  Full E8 A2 fiber A; binary dim V <= 6; V outside span(A)
- Upper bound 30; outside equality and actual P112 sharpness unclaimed
+ Sharp 30; analytic 1080 equality spaces per fiber
+ Actual P112 witness 20 roots / 10 fiber roots; canonical 144 equality spaces
```

Add one isolated package, `research/e8-a2-outside-rank6`. The proof classifies equality as 216 eligible intersections with five extensions each. This prevents replacing the inherited separate 20/10 support capacities by a stronger universal outside inequality. PR3288 retains credit for upper 30, its joint 32 proof and contained equality 27; PR3262 retains the original joint 32 result.

The universal 3360-fiber model binding and global 12/20 capacity premises remain inherited from pinned PR3288 `c375ed42aabf1b8cdcaae0cc565540d0eda9fa0e`. Two exact predecessor payloads are retained with original paths, commit/blob/SHA256 and fixed usage/schema controls. Fresh replay needs no pending-PR Git object. Canonical base `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority revision 6.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3288 expressly left outside-span 30 sharpness unclaimed.
- After: analytic 1080 count, a literal binary rank-six P112 witness, and two complete canonical enumerations agree on all 32004 relevant spaces and full histograms. Seven behavioral control groups pass.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay passes. Every direct script passes in the exact committed regular-only, inode-disjoint, read-only Git-free export under normal 3.12 and optimized 3.13. Export integrity and all 14 publication package/input byte comparisons pass.

```sh
python3 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/e8-a2-outside-rank6
```

Peer review and source/check receipts are retained in the package. The canonical P112 count 144 is asserted only for the displayed fiber. Historical large flat and universal-fiber censuses, Lean, Docker and selected cold replay are unrun. This is internal computational review, with no human or proof-kernel approval claimed. Open next questions require a named caller's simultaneous compatibility constraints.

Credit Nick Petalas/PR3288/3280/3269/3262, David Arias's quadratic model, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 and the retained E8/P112 lineage including joaqcoo. The simultaneous rank 7 capacity and mixed5/6/6 common-cut investigations have distinct predicates and are unused.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One opt-in support-geometry package. No new shortening threshold, caller exclusion, scalar factors, decoder floor, physical/frame/restoration/consumer implementation, supplier, kappa or selected-frontier update follows. Archival intake is separate from scientific admission.
